hooks.command: Set-Location 'd:\Development\leadkart-go'; $h=(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>$null); $b=(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null); $d=((git status --porcelain 2>$null)|Measure-Object).Count; $ctx="repo state: HEAD=$h branch=$b dirty=$d files"; $out=@{ hookSpecificOutput=@{ hookEventName='SessionStart'; additionalContext=$ctx } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out; exit 0

Set-Location 'd:\Development\leadkart-go'; go build ./... 2>$null; $b=$LASTEXITCODE; go test -run '^TestArch_' ./internal/architecture/... 2>$null; $a=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($b -ne 0 -or $a -ne 0) { $m="VERIFY WARNING: build=$b arch=$a (non-zero = RED). Do not claim green / commit until fixed."; $out=@{ systemMessage=$m } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }; exit 0
